latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Fiverr Gig Optimizer with comprehensive coaching for gig-based marketplace sellers.

- Diagnoses and addresses issues across the full sales funnel, from impressions to repeat buyers.
- Provides actionable advice for optimizing gig titles, descriptions, packages, pricing, and visuals.
- Includes Fiverr SEO strategies: title/tag formulas, benchmarks, and ranking factors.
- Offers tailored advice for both new and experienced sellers, including level progression tips.
- Benchmarks healthy gig metrics and identifies blockers for impressions, click-through, and conversions.
- Targeted usage for freelancers on Fiverr, Creative Market, and similar platforms.
